summary: Moves a library onto the graph once: a pre-migration copy, a dry run whose counts must match, then every legacy row and workspace value as entries.

faults.when: The dry run's planned counts differ from what was read; nothing is written and the legacy panels stay.
A migrated preset doesn't serialise to its source row's bytes.

lifetime: Once per library, at the first start of a build that has the graph.

x-friction.gap: Legacy revisions must keep their saved times.
x-friction.closes: Import entries with an original time.

x-friction.gap: Workspace data from newer builds (otherFeatures) must be carried unchanged.
